document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Something grabs you. Make a STR roll: if successful, you tear 
from the grasp and escape to 33. If failed, and a second thing 
grabs you. Their combined STR is 140: make an opposed roll 
against the combined strength. Succeed, and you squirm out of 
their grasps, escaping to 33. Fail, and a third one grips you, and 
all three begin tearing at your flesh. You fill the chill air with 
your screams. It is ... THE END. (14, 18)
